# saltline/php

> Saltline API client for PHP 8.1+. Connects end users' third-party accounts, calls those
> providers' APIs through Saltline, manages provider webhooks, and signs users in with OAuth2.
> Works with any PSR-18 HTTP client (auto-discovered). Holds the secret API key: server-side only.

This file is for AI coding assistants. Follow the rules first; the reference follows.

## Rules

1. **Never expose the API key.** Never echo it, put it in JavaScript, or send it to the browser.
   Browser code uses `@aszura/saltline-browser`, which talks only to your PHP endpoints.
2. **PKCE on every connect and sign-in.** `init` takes a `codeChallenge`; `claim` needs the
   matching `codeVerifier`. Nothing is live until claimed. Keep the verifier in the starting
   user's `$_SESSION`, or in the browser's `sessionStorage` via `@aszura/saltline-browser`.
   **Never store it in a table or cache keyed by `connectionKey` or `sessionKey`**, because the key
   appears in the redirect URL.
3. **Claim once.** Single-use, expires 30 minutes after the provider step. `unset()` the stored
   verifier when you read it.
4. **Set `auth`, `redirectUrl` and the provider on the server.** If the request picks a provider,
   check it against an allowlist with `in_array(..., true)`.
5. **Branch on `$e->errorCode`, never `$e->getMessage()`.** Unknown codes: fall back to `$e->status`.
6. **Proxy responses are the provider's.** `$saltline->proxy->request()` returns a PSR-7
   `ResponseInterface` for every provider status. Check `getStatusCode()` yourself. Only Saltline's own
   refusals throw.
7. **Verify webhooks with the raw body** (`file_get_contents('php://input')`), never a
   re-encoded `json_decode` result.
8. Persist `$connection['connectionKey']` against your user after `claim`. It's the handle for
   every later proxy, refresh, revoke and webhook call.
9. All responses are associative arrays (shapes below), not objects. Exceptions:
   `ConnectionRedirect` (object) and proxy responses (PSR-7).
10. **Serving `@aszura/saltline-browser`? Use `Saltline\ConnectFlow` / `Saltline\SignInFlow`.**
    They are the start and finish endpoints the browser package calls. Don't hand-write those
    endpoints or keep the provider in `$_SESSION`: the browser sends it with the finish payload.

## Install and create a client

```php
// composer require saltline/php   (plus a PSR-18 client, e.g. guzzlehttp/guzzle)
$saltline = new Saltline\Client(
    apiKey: getenv('SALTLINE_API_KEY'),
    // environment: 'staging',          // default 'production'
    // baseUrl: 'https://…/v1',          // overrides environment; include /v1
    // httpClient: $psr18Client,         // requestFactory:, streamFactory: also accepted
);
```

## Connect a user's account

```php
// Start (behind your login):
$pkce = Saltline\Pkce::create();
$result = $saltline->connections->init('google', [
    'auth' => 'oAuth2',
    'redirectUrl' => 'https://yourapp.com/connected',
    'codeChallenge' => $pkce['codeChallenge'],
    'codeChallengeMethod' => $pkce['codeChallengeMethod'], // 'S256'
    'externalUserId' => (string) $user->id,                // optional
]);
$_SESSION['saltline_connect'] = $pkce['codeVerifier'];
header('Location: ' . $result['authorizationUrl']);
exit;

// Return at /connected, same browser session:
$redirect = Saltline\ConnectionRedirect::parse($_SERVER['REQUEST_URI']);
$codeVerifier = $_SESSION['saltline_connect'] ?? null;
unset($_SESSION['saltline_connect']);
if ($redirect->ok && $codeVerifier !== null) {
    $connection = $saltline->connections->claim('google', $redirect->connectionKey, $codeVerifier);
    saveConnection($user->id, $connection['connectionKey']);
} elseif (!$redirect->ok) {
    // $redirect->error, $redirect->errorMessage: declined or provider failure
}
```

## Serve `@aszura/saltline-browser` (browser-side PKCE)

When the browser package makes the pair, mount its two endpoints with `ConnectFlow` (or
`SignInFlow`). Both run behind your own login.

```php
$connect = new Saltline\ConnectFlow(
    $saltline,
    ['google', 'trello'],                 // allowlist; or ['trello' => ['integrationKey' => '…', 'auth' => 'oAuth1']]
    'https://yourapp.com/connected',      // or fn (string $provider): string
    // auth: 'oAuth2', theme: 'light'|'dark'
);

// Plain PHP: reads php://input, sets the status, echoes JSON.
// POST /saltline/start
$connect->serveStart(externalUserId: (string) $user->id);
// POST /saltline/finish
$connect->serveFinish(function (array $claimed) use ($user): array {
    saveConnection($user->id, $claimed['connection']['connectionKey']);
    return ['connected' => true];         // answered as JSON; null answers ['ok' => true]
});

// Laravel / Symfony / any framework: the same as ['status' => int, 'body' => array].
$reply = $connect->replyStart($request->json()->all(), externalUserId: (string) $user->id);
return response()->json($reply['body'], $reply['status']);
$reply = $connect->replyFinish($request->json()->all(), fn (array $claimed) => save($claimed));

// Lowest level, throwing instead of replying:
$started = $connect->start($input, externalUserId: '…'); // ['provider', 'connectionKey', 'authorizationUrl']
$claimed = $connect->finish($input);                      // ['provider', 'connectionKey', 'connection' => [...]]
```

`SignInFlow($saltline, $providers, $redirectUrl, ?theme)` is the same for sign-in: start answers
`['provider', 'sessionKey', 'authorizationUrl']`, finish gives `['provider', 'sessionKey', 'user', 'raw']`.

Input: start takes `{provider, codeChallenge, codeChallengeMethod: 'S256'}`, finish takes
`{provider, connectionKey|sessionKey, codeVerifier}`, exactly what the browser package sends. Bad
input throws `Saltline\FlowInputException` (`$status` 400, `$errorCode` `UNKNOWN_PROVIDER` or
`INVALID_INPUT`). `reply*` / `serve*` answer `['code', 'error', 'requestId'?]`: 400 for bad input
or a claim Saltline refused (`CONNECTION_NOT_FOUND`, `SESSION_NOT_FOUND`, `CODE_VERIFIER_MISMATCH`,
`MISSING_PKCE_PARAMETERS`), 502 for any other `SaltlineException`; anything else is rethrown.
`Saltline\Flow::errorReply(\Throwable $e)` gives that reply (or null) for your own handlers, and
`$connect->providers()` lists the allowlist.

## Sign users in

```php
$pkce = Saltline\Pkce::create();
$result = $saltline->sessions->init('google', [
    'auth' => 'oAuth2',
    'redirectUrl' => 'https://yourapp.com/signed-in',
    'codeChallenge' => $pkce['codeChallenge'],
    'codeChallengeMethod' => 'S256',
]);
$_SESSION['saltline'] = ['sessionKey' => $result['sessionKey'], 'codeVerifier' => $pkce['codeVerifier']];
// redirect to $result['authorizationUrl'], then at /signed-in:
$pending = $_SESSION['saltline'];
unset($_SESSION['saltline']);
$info = $saltline->sessions->claim('google', $pending['sessionKey'], $pending['codeVerifier']);
$info['user']; // normalized user; $info['raw'] is the provider's payload
```

## Call a provider's API

```php
$response = $saltline->proxy->request('GET', 'trello', '1/members/me/boards', $connectionKey);
if ($response->getStatusCode() >= 400) { /* provider error */ }
$boards = json_decode((string) $response->getBody(), true);

$saltline->proxy->request(
    'POST', 'github', 'repos/acme/app/issues', $connectionKey,
    body: ['title' => 'Bug'],                         // sent as JSON
    query: ['per_page' => '50'],
    headers: ['Accept' => 'application/vnd.github+json'],
    // contentType: 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded', version: '2022-11-28', integrationKey: '…',
);
```

`$path` must be non-empty and contain no `..` segment. Caller headers starting with `x-saltline-`
are dropped.

Async: `$saltline->proxy->enqueue($method, $provider, $path, $connectionKey, $callbackUrl, ...)`
returns `['requestId' => …]` (HTTP 202). The provider's response is POSTed to `$callbackUrl`
(public HTTPS). Verify it with `Signature::verifyWebhook`.

## Webhooks

```php
$raw = file_get_contents('php://input');
if (!Saltline\Signature::verifyWebhook(getallheaders(), $raw, getenv('SALTLINE_SIGNING_SECRET'))) {
    http_response_code(401);
    exit;
}
$event = json_decode($raw, true);
```

`$secrets` may be an array during rotation. Default tolerance is 300 s. It never throws.
`Signature::verifyMessage($psr7Message, $secrets)` works on PSR-7 requests/responses and rewinds the
body. `Signature::verify($body, $timestamp, $signature, $secrets)` is the low-level form.

```php
$saltline->webhooks->register('github', $connectionKey, body: [/* kind-specific */], kind: 'push', metadata: 'repo-42');
$saltline->webhooks->list('github', $connectionKey);
$saltline->webhooks->get('github', $webhookKey, $connectionKey);
$saltline->webhooks->update('github', $webhookKey, $connectionKey, body: [...]);
$saltline->webhooks->delete('github', $webhookKey, $connectionKey);
$manual = $saltline->webhooks->initManual('stripe', $connectionKey, redirectUrl: 'https://yourapp.com/done');
// paste $manual['ingressUrl'] at the provider, send the user to $manual['setupUrl']
```

## API reference

All methods throw `Saltline\SaltlineException` on a Saltline error. `?string $integrationKey` is
only needed when a provider has several integrations and no default.

| Call | Returns |
| --- | --- |
| `connections->init(string $provider, array{auth, redirectUrl, codeChallenge, codeChallengeMethod: 'S256', externalUserId?, theme?: 'light'\|'dark'} $body, ?string $integrationKey = null)` | `array{connectionKey, authorizationUrl, message?}` |
| `connections->claim(string $provider, string $connectionKey, string $codeVerifier)` | Connection array |
| `connections->refresh(string $provider, string $connectionKey)` | Connection array (409 `CONFLICT` if a refresh is running) |
| `connections->revoke(string $provider, string $connectionKey, ?string $integrationKey = null)` | `void` |
| `connections->list(string $provider, string $integrationKey)` | `list<Connection>` |
| `sessions->init(string $provider, array{auth: 'oAuth2', redirectUrl, codeChallenge, codeChallengeMethod, externalUserId?, theme?} $body, ?string $integrationKey = null)` | `array{sessionKey, authorizationUrl, message?}` |
| `sessions->claim(string $provider, string $sessionKey, string $codeVerifier)` | `array{user, raw}` |
| `sessions->userinfo(string $provider, string $sessionKey, ?string $integrationKey = null)` | `array{user, raw}` |
| `sessions->refresh(string $provider, string $sessionKey)` | Session array |
| `sessions->revoke(string $provider, string $sessionKey, ?string $integrationKey = null)` | `void` |
| `sessions->list(string $provider, ?string $integrationKey = null)` | `list<Session>` |
| `proxy->request(string $method, string $provider, string $path, string $connectionKey, mixed $body = null, array $query = [], array $headers = [], ?string $integrationKey = null, ?string $version = null, ?string $contentType = null)` | `Psr\Http\Message\ResponseInterface` |
| `proxy->enqueue(string $method, string $provider, string $path, string $connectionKey, string $callbackUrl, …same optional args)` | `array{requestId}` |
| `webhooks->register(string $provider, string $connectionKey, array $body = [], ?string $kind = null, ?string $webhookKey = null, ?string $metadata = null, ?string $version = null, ?string $integrationKey = null)` | `array{success, webhookKey, providerWebhookId?, kind?}` |
| `webhooks->list(string $provider, string $connectionKey, ?string $integrationKey = null)` | `list<Webhook>` |
| `webhooks->get(string $provider, string $webhookKey, string $connectionKey, ?string $integrationKey = null)` | Webhook array |
| `webhooks->update(string $provider, string $webhookKey, string $connectionKey, array $body = [], ?string $version = null, ?string $integrationKey = null)` | `array{success, webhookKey, …}` |
| `webhooks->delete(string $provider, string $webhookKey, string $connectionKey, ?string $version = null, ?string $integrationKey = null)` | `array{success, webhookKey, …}` |
| `webhooks->initManual(string $provider, string $connectionKey, ?string $redirectUrl = null, ?string $integrationKey = null)` | `array{sessionId, webhookKey, setupUrl, ingressUrl, status: 'pending', fields}` |
| `environment->integrations()` | `list<array>` |
| `environment->identityProviders()` | `list<array>` |

Browser-flow classes: `Saltline\ConnectFlow(Client $saltline, array $providers, string|\Closure $redirectUrl, string $auth = 'oAuth2', ?string $theme = null)`
and `Saltline\SignInFlow(Client $saltline, array $providers, string|\Closure $redirectUrl, ?string $theme = null)`,
both with `start(mixed $input, ?string $externalUserId = null)`, `finish(mixed $input)`,
`replyStart(mixed $input, ?string $externalUserId = null)`, `replyFinish(mixed $input, callable $onClaimed)`
→ `['status' => int, 'body' => array]`, `serveStart(?string $externalUserId = null)`,
`serveFinish(callable $onClaimed)`, `providers()`; `Saltline\FlowInputException` (`$status`, `$errorCode`);
`Saltline\Flow::errorReply(\Throwable $e)`.

Static helpers: `Saltline\Pkce::create()` → `['codeVerifier', 'codeChallenge', 'codeChallengeMethod' => 'S256']`;
`Saltline\ConnectionRedirect::parse(string $url)` → object with `ok`, `connectionKey`, `error`,
`errorMessage` (`error` is `'missing_connection_key'` when the URL has neither param);
`Saltline\Signature::verifyWebhook / verifyMessage / verify`.

Connection array keys: `connectionKey, providerKey, integrationKey, externalUserId?,
providerUserId?, authType, status, grantedScopes?, expiresAt?, lastRefreshedAt?, lastUsedAt?,
lastError?, lastErrorAt?, createdAt, updatedAt, disconnectedAt?`. Session arrays have the same
keys with `sessionKey` in place of `connectionKey`. `authType` is one of `oAuth1, oAuth2, api_key,
basic, session`. `status` is one of `active, pending, reauth_required, error, revoked, inactive`.

## Errors

```php
try {
    $saltline->connections->refresh('google', $connectionKey);
} catch (Saltline\SaltlineException $e) {
    $e->status;     // HTTP status
    $e->errorCode;  // stable code; "HTTP_<status>" if none was sent
    $e->requestId;  // quote in support requests
    $e->body;       // decoded JSON or raw text
    if ($e->errorCode === 'CONFLICT') { /* refresh already running; retry shortly */ }
}
```

Common codes: `INVALID_API_KEY`, `API_KEY_EXPIRED`, `IP_NOT_ALLOWED`, `RATE_LIMITED`,
`LIMIT_EXCEEDED`, `CONFLICT`, `PROVIDER_NOT_FOUND`, `INTEGRATION_NOT_FOUND`,
`INTEGRATION_KEY_REQUIRED` (pass `$integrationKey`), `CONNECTION_NOT_FOUND`, `SESSION_NOT_FOUND`,
`WEBHOOK_NOT_FOUND`, `MISSING_PKCE_PARAMETERS`, `CODE_VERIFIER_MISMATCH` (wrong or reused
verifier; start again), `AUTH_TYPE_NOT_SUPPORTED`, `BLOCKED_PATH`. The full list is in
`openapi.yaml` under `components.schemas.Error`.
